headline: Axon Enterprise Reports Q3 2026 Revenue of $909 Million
summary: Axon Enterprise reported a 28% year-over-year revenue increase to $909 million for Q3 2026. The company also increased its stake in drone manufacturer Skydio to 37%.
why: Axon Enterprise is a major provider of law enforcement technology, including Tasers and body cameras, and is increasingly focused on software and AI-driven public safety platforms.

impacts.name: Axon Enterprise
impacts.why: Strong revenue growth and strategic investments often drive positive investor sentiment.
